status: frozen 2026-10-06: cross-city model; fit authorized by the user's C6 decision; any change is sp_chicago_model_v2
families: the 12 families and 20 columns of analysis/config/chicago_model_v1.json (definitions, tables and SHA-256), São Paulo rows from the same tables
u3_sao_paulo_definition: Census 2022 residents per km2 of land (S3-0 catch-up)
missing: U1 under 10% classified occupied land: Marsilac, Parelheiros, O'Hare; available-case distance (J-8)

c6_scaling.u6_composition: city-centred log-ratios (relative); all-absolute uses raw log-ratios

model.scaling: z-score, population SD, capped at +-3, over 173 units (absolute) or within each city (relative)
model.budgets: equal per family; U6 = 1/2 intensity + 1/2 Aitchison composition
model.calibration: median positive pairwise value over all 14,878 pairs

runs.R2: PCA of the R1 geometry, fewest components >= 90%
runs.R3: drop scalar columns while any pair |Spearman| >= 0.70 on the scaled 173 values

model.robustness: 500 weight draws (seed 20261006, x U(0.5,1.5), 80% stability), leave-one-family-out, J-9 alternatives
model.implementation: analysis/scripts/sp_chicago_model.py (reuses analysis/scripts/chicago_model.py); notebook analysis/sp_chicago_model_analysis.ipynb; report docs/harmonization/MODEL_REPORT.md
